envelope.description: Verify before resuming: receiving repo, branch lookup, checkpoint and upstream

body.title: Verify before resuming: receiving repo, branch lookup, checkpoint and upstream
body.summary: Add verifyReceivingRepo (path registered through listRepos, repository identity by the root commit id) and resumeCheck(repo, unit, opts): the author gate with the workflow, the registration and identity check before anything is fetched or restored, ls-remote to tell a missing branch from a failure, fetch of the branch into a temporary ref, checkpoint validation, comparison of the whole upstream snapshot with current revisions, the stage inference and the dirty-file check. It returns a validated restore plan, or restart, nothing-to-resume or refused, and changes no working file.
acceptanceChecks: An unregistered path and a clone of a different repository are refused before any file is restored
A moved upstream (including revision 0 on both sides, the effective HLD and the Define) is refused
A missing branch returns restart while a network or permission failure is refused with the git message
An unknown schema, a unit mismatch, a path outside the unit and a dirty target file are each refused with the specific reason
A committed LLD with no PLAN infers plan and both committed returns nothing-to-resume

tests.name: src/workflow/team/__tests__/handoff-resume-check.test.ts: resumeCheck refuses an unregistered receiving path and a clone of a different repository before restoring anything, and refuses a moved upstream including the effective HLD and the Define
